additional_concerns: The extraction notes incorrectly say footnotes 1 and 4 are missing. Both are supplied; the external instruments they reference are not.

The Advertising Guidelines reference includes applicable FAQs and other SFC guidance under footnote 4. The advertising claim is supported as a summary, not as an exhaustive statement of those principles.

Code of Conduct paragraph 3.11 and the answer to question 1 of the SFC's 30 September 2010 FAQs are missing external authorities relevant to the gift restriction. No dependency IDs are supplied. Their applicable versions are needed to verify qualifications beyond the circular.

node.2a6321b4ce90763bf0be564e places offering in Scope, so an unoffered component returns OUT_OF_SCOPE rather than FALSE. node.6d6e7adc6faa9d94b74c08e5, node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5, node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 similarly place promotional linkage in Scope. Reconcile these outcomes with the typed questions before treating them as complete Boolean answers; a deliberately narrower assessment domain remains a possible interpretation.

node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6 combine offer-level promotion with an existential gift component without expressly binding the promotional link to that component. Mixed-purpose offers could be overincluded unless the supplied classifications enforce that connection.

The circular defines distributors in the context of SFC-authorised funds, while its paragraph 3.11 quotation refers to investment products generally. node.97af37a2579f59b0ee43211f expressly narrows the promoted product to SFC-authorised funds. This may preserve the circular's selected scope but does not establish a complete implementation of the broader Code provision.

For node.142f34016b300f5c110eb249, provider must identify the distributor making the offer, not merely its funder or fulfiller. node.bc55be7e973a689d07f9e64b expressly requires offer attribution; its statements about funding and fulfilment should not be extended into categorical attribution rules unsupported by the supplied source.

Gift classification remains a supplied judgment. The source says incentives may be gifts; it does not automatically prohibit every guaranteed return or require a non-structured-product finding before the gift restriction can apply.
A discount exception, non-gift finding or selected gift-control compliance result does not confer permission under the separate disclosure, advertising or structured-product requirements.
No operative date interval is established by the supplied text. Temporal runtime semantics cannot establish the applicable historical versions of external authorities.
The pairwise NOT_APPLICABLE findings retain the separate duties. They neither authorize pruning nor establish overall executable correctness.
